note: Pretrial record of State of Florida v. Shanna Gardner, Duval County Circuit Court, before Judge London Kite. No trial testimony yet — jury selection is set for May 3, 2027. Everything below is drawn from court filings and attributed reporting. Jared Bridegan's surviving children are minors and are not named or described here.

pretrial.event: Jared Bridegan, 33, a Microsoft manager, is shot and killed on a residential street in Jacksonville Beach after stopping to move a tire left in the road. His young child is in the car. No one is arrested for almost a year.
Henry Tenon is charged in the murder. He rents a property from Mario Fernandez Saldana, who is married to Bridegan's ex-wife, Shanna Gardner.
Tenon pleads guilty to second-degree murder and agrees to testify against Gardner and Fernandez. At the time, that cooperation is the spine of the state's case against both.

sources.outlet: News4Jax/WJXT — Tenon moves to withdraw guilty plea

pretrial.event: Shanna Gardner is arrested and charged with four counts: first-degree murder, conspiracy to commit murder, solicitation to commit a capital felony, and child abuse. She pleads not guilty.

sources.outlet: News4Jax/WJXT — trial delayed, state to seek joint trial

pretrial.event: Prosecutors withdraw their notice to seek the death penalty against both Gardner and Fernandez, capping the murder count at life in prison.
Judge London Kite denies Gardner's motion to suppress evidence gathered from court-authorized wiretaps, leaving that evidence available to the state.
Mario Fernandez is convicted of first-degree murder and solicitation to commit a capital felony in Bridegan's death — the first of the three defendants to be tried.

sources.outlet: Action News Jax — jury deliberations / verdict

pretrial.event: On an unopposed defense motion, Judge Kite continues Gardner's trial to 2027: jury selection May 3, trial May 10. Prosecutors say they will take the Gardner and Tenon cases to the grand jury to have them joined for a single 2027 trial. A defense filing argues Fernandez may have had a separate motive of his own.
